facts.fact: 清晨醒来只觉悲伤麻木，自觉纽约情伤未愈。
facts.anchor: I wake in the morning feeling the kind of desperate sadness and hollow loneliness I thought I’d left behind

facts.fact: 两人突然不接电话不应门，三人关系就此了结。
facts.anchor: And then, without warning, they stopped taking my calls. They didn’t answer the door when I knocked. And just like that, we were done.

facts.fact: 她到男友 Declan 公寓赴约，开门的却是自称 Jessa 的陌生美人。
facts.anchor: “I’m Jessa.” The woman who answers the door is gorgeous.

facts.fact: Jessa 告知开放关系，还说一直等着见她。
facts.anchor: Declan and I have an open relationship. I’ve actually been waiting to meet you.

facts.fact: 她考虑了整整三秒便点头同意加入。
facts.anchor: I think it over for a whole three seconds. I like him, and I like kissing Jessa, and this is New York.

facts.fact: 此后八个月她大多与两人同床，脚边伴着两只德牧。
facts.anchor: The next eight months of my life were a whirlwind. I spent most of it in Jessa and Declan’s bed with their two German shepherds at our feet.

facts.fact: 两周前她收拾残存的一切飞回德州。
facts.anchor: And two weeks ago, I packed up all that was left—tiny little shreds of the woman I used to be—and I flew home

facts.fact: Mayo 一岁时未达展示标准被送拍，那天他们共买回三匹马。
facts.anchor: He was sent to auction, and Grandaddy Smith, Mom, and I were there to look at another horse. We brought three home that day, Mayo included.
